name: {{name}}
description: Stack calm pebbles one at a time. A small starting point for your own activity.
author: {{author}}

help.summary: Stack pebbles until the cairn is ten high.
howToPlay: Press Add a pebble to place one on top.
Press Take one off if you change your mind.
At ten, the cairn is done. Start again whenever you like.

controls.action: Add or take off a pebble

tips: You can stop at any time. Your cairn is saved.
